description: Conformance vectors for the adaptive harness (06_AgentZone/09_Adaptive_Harness.md, PROPOSED), the test-design stage (KAN-47). Each decision or record case applies JSON Patches (RFC 6902 add, replace, remove) to the base example and its context; the expected violations are the names of the reference checker's checks (tests/contracts/harness_reference.py), 'schema' and 'record_schema' meaning the locked schema rejects the document. A designed-to-fail case must be caught, and must pass through when its expected checks are switched off. Every violation is emitted as a ddi.event.v1 (kind error) and a ddi.capa_draft.v1 citing eep-rule IDs, validated against the agent-ddi-harness schemas at the commit pinned in tests/contracts/harness_conformance/ddi_pin.json.
